# Every

> All-in-one startup finance platform providing incorporation, banking, payroll, taxes, bookkeeping, and treasury management.

Every is a Y Combinator-backed fintech platform serving 1,000+ startups. It consolidates essential back-office operations—from Delaware C-Corp formation to FDIC-insured banking and automated compliance—into a single integrated platform designed to save founders time and reduce operational complexity.

## Key Topics

- Startup Finance
- Back-Office Automation
- Incorporation
- Startup Banking
- Payroll & HR
- Tax Compliance
- Treasury Management
- Bookkeeping
- Cash Management
- Financial Platform
- FDIC Insurance
- Delaware C-Corp
- EIN Setup
- Fintech
- Y Combinator

## Core Services

- [Incorporation - Free for Startups!](https://www.every.io/incorporation): Delaware C-Corp incorporation with EIN, banking setup in under a week.
- [Startup Banking Made Simple | Every](https://www.every.io/banking): Business bank accounts with Visa cards, bill payments, FDIC insurance.
- [Payroll & HR](https://www.every.io/payroll-hr): Payroll automation, tax compliance, benefits, and HR management platform.
- [Bookkeeping](https://www.every.io/bookkeeping): Automated bookkeeping with expert review and monthly financial reports.
- [Taxes](https://www.every.io/taxes): Federal, state, and local tax filing with expert guidance and compliance.
- [Treasury Management for Startups | Every](https://www.every.io/treasury): Treasury tools for cash management, yield optimization, and investments.
